fields.statement: QA: built ./cmd/rhiza to a scratch path; rhiza workflow describe ship-change lists the 12 steps with merge fail -> rebase, rebase pass -> wait-ci / fail -> handback:conduct, pr-green fail -> handback:conduct, wait-ci timeout -> handback:conduct, no on.fail on main-ci/close-out/ship/deploy-check; toml has wait-ci until 'rhiza ship check --settled' (no --no-rebase), rebase stall 70m, max_visits 6, handback_cap 3, conduct prompt without --no-push; go test ./internal/workflow -run 'TestBuiltinShipChange|TestPlainRedLoopsShipChangeHasNone|TestMergeWithoutGate' and TestScripts/workflow-new pass

QA: built binary's rhiza guide conduct-handback has pr-green and rebase routes, none for merge, says never run rhiza ship rebase; conduct-roles conflict-fix names a conflict the ship steps leave in progress; workflows lists the 12 steps; docs/examples/byo/conductor.toml passes rhiza workflow check in a scratch repo with wait-ci/pr-green/merge/rebase routed as ship-change's, and a broken copy fails with named steps (exit 1); greps for --no-rebase, 'ten steps', 'ship rebase --no-push' find nothing; go test ./internal/guide and TestDocsPrimitives|TestDocsExampleWorkflows|TestDocsBringYourOwn|TestScripts/guide pass

QA: TestScripts/ship-change-one-ci passes; its assertions cover merge fail -> rebase pass -> wait-ci/pr-green/merge visit 2 with conduct once, no handback, two pushes and one pr merge, and the conflict case rebase fail -> conduct visit 2 -> gate, signoff, push, merge; rhiza check in a clean detached checkout at HEAD exits 0 and rhiza render leaves the tree clean (fixer's rendered index order holds)
